description: Land Acquisition - Walagammedda, Kandy & Gangawata Korale D/S Division, Kandy District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1957/02 of 08.03.2016 by Nuwara Eliya D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired (including lot numbers, boundaries, extents, and claimant information), which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property matters. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
